purpose: Registry-driven Islamic source adapters. Existing providers remain enabled; additional verified Sunni-oriented and broad Islamic providers are additive. AI/search services are discovery and cross-reference tools only and are never treated as the religious source of generated text.

adapters.name: About Islam
adapters.verification: Official About Islam page describes the project as an online dawah initiative presenting mainstream Islam and supporting Muslims, new Muslims and youth.
adapters.release_policy: Verify item-level rights and current site terms before redistribution.

adapters.name: General Presidency for Scholarly Research and Ifta
adapters.verification: Official site provides the Permanent Committee for Fatwa, Senior Scholars Secretariat and Islamic Research publications.
adapters.release_policy: Verify item-level rights before redistribution.

adapters.name: Al-Islam Institute International
adapters.description: International Islamic education institute offering Quran, Hadith, Fiqh and Arabic education.
adapters.verification_note: Official site describes structured Quranic, Hadith, Fiqh and Arabic education and an online resource library.

adapters.name: Alukah
adapters.release_policy: Verify item-level rights and site notices before public redistribution.

adapters.name: Bayyinah TV

adapters.release_policy: Course/video availability does not grant redistribution permission; verify item-level terms.

adapters.name: Dar al-Ifta al-Misriyyah

adapters.release_policy: Institutional publication does not by itself grant redistribution permission; verify item-level rights.

adapters.name: Dorar.net
adapters.release_policy: Use official API/site terms and verify item-level redistribution rights before public release.

adapters.name: Hadith Academy

adapters.source_role: Islamic education and hadith study discovery
adapters.verification_note: Official institute site documents its Sharia studies and da'wah preparation mission and presents Hadith Academy material and connected ijazah offerings.

adapters.name: Imam Shatibi Institute
adapters.verification: Official institute site documents Quran memorization, Tajweed, Qira'at and Ijazah-oriented study, with UK branches and distance-learning options.

adapters.name: International Open University (IOU)

adapters.release_policy: Course/library access does not itself grant redistribution rights; verify item-level rights and library terms.

adapters.name: Islamic Content Encyclopedia (IslamEnc)
adapters.verification: Official site states it provides Quran translations/tafsir, verified scholarly books, hadith/rulings encyclopedias, 100+ languages and an API.

adapters.name: IslamHouse

adapters.name: IslamQA.info
adapters.methodology_note: The site states that it promotes Ahl al-Sunnah wa'l-Jama'ah and draws on the four Sunni madhhabs and other scholars.
adapters.release_policy: Website availability does not imply redistribution permission; verify item-level rights before public release.

adapters.name: IslamQA.org

adapters.release_policy: Preserve original scholar/institution provenance; verify rights at original-source and item level before redistribution.

adapters.name: IslamReligion.com

adapters.release_policy: Verify item-level rights before redistribution.

adapters.name: SeekersGuidance

adapters.release_policy: Educational availability does not itself grant redistribution rights; verify item-level terms/permission.

adapters.name: Tanzil Quran Project

adapters.name: Tarteel

adapters.name: Tebyan Academy

adapters.name: Yaqeen Institute for Islamic Research
adapters.verification: Official site provides research papers, reports, datasets and educational materials on Quran, hadith, Islamic law, history and contemporary Muslim topics; its FAQ states that papers are free to read/share/cite for academic and educational use.
adapters.release_policy: Record the exact item license/terms and preserve attribution; free access does not automatically mean unrestricted redistribution of every asset.

adapters.name: Zad Academy
adapters.verification: Official academy material describes a two-year distance program covering aqidah, tafsir, hadith, fiqh, seerah, Arabic and Islamic upbringing.
adapters.release_policy: Course availability does not imply redistribution rights; verify item-level terms.

adapters.name: Zadi
adapters.verification: Official Zadi platform provides online Islamic learning tracks and courses; it is distinct from Zad Academy.
adapters.release_policy: Course availability does not grant redistribution rights; verify item-level terms.

adapters.name: Zekr Project
adapters.verification: Project source identifies Zekr as an open-source Quran study project; bundled resources carry separate licenses and must not be conflated.
adapters.release_policy: Respect GPL and each bundled resource's separate license; verify translation-specific rights.

adapters.name: ChatIslamOnline.org

adapters.release_policy: Discovery only unless item-level rights and current site terms are verified.

adapters.name: Sultan Islamic Links
adapters.verification: Official site is an Islamic resource directory covering Quran, Sunnah, fiqh, fatwa, free books, multilingual resources and search pages; its pages were updated in March 2026.
adapters.release_policy: Treat linked third-party resources as separate sources; verify original-source provenance and item-level rights before acquisition or redistribution.

adapters.name: International Islamic Fiqh Academy
adapters.verification: Official Academy site publishes scholarly resolutions and research, including dedicated material on Fiqh of Minorities and citizenship outside Muslim countries.
adapters.release_policy: Use official publication metadata and verify item-level rights before redistribution.

adapters.name: Basaer Academy
adapters.verification: Official site describes Quran, Tajweed, Arabic and Islamic Studies programs, including Fiqh, Hadith, Tafsir and Seerah, for international learners.
adapters.release_policy: Educational access does not grant redistribution rights; verify item-level rights before public release.

adapters.name: Al-Fitrah Academy UK
adapters.verification: Official academy site identifies Al-Fitrah as a non-profit organization providing Quran and Sunnah education; its Quran program includes Qaida, Quran, Islamic Studies and Hifz.
adapters.release_policy: Verify item-level rights before redistribution.

adapters.name: Noon Quran
adapters.verification: Official site describes a UAE-based online Quran learning platform offering recitation, memorization, Tajweed and Quran translation courses.
adapters.release_policy: Course availability does not grant redistribution rights; verify item-level rights and permissions.

adapters.name: International Islamic College Leicester
adapters.verification: Official college site describes institutes for Quran, Arabic, Islamic Sciences and Traditional Mutoon & Ijaazaat, with published courses and scholarly governance.
adapters.release_policy: Educational access does not grant redistribution rights; verify item-level rights.

adapters.name: IslamToday.net
adapters.verification: Independent academic and institutional references document IslamToday.net as an Islamic educational portal with multilingual resources and fatwa material; current site availability/rights should be checked item-by-item before acquisition.
adapters.release_policy: Do not infer redistribution rights from historical availability; verify current item-level rights.

adapters.name: IslamLand
adapters.methodology_note: Official site describes a multilingual Islamic portal with books, articles, Quran, fatwas, video and audio; its current catalogue prominently includes works by Sunni scholars such as Ibn Baz and Muhammad Salih Al-Munajjid.
adapters.release_policy: Use as a discovery/content source; verify exact item, provenance and redistribution rights before release.

adapters.name: Explore Islam
adapters.methodology_note: Official project page describes a nonprofit project launched in 2015 providing Islamic research/content, with multilingual articles, books, videos, Quran topics and new-Muslim resources.
adapters.release_policy: Treat as a complementary discovery/dawah source; verify item-level rights and publisher/source terms before redistribution.

adapters.name: The New Muslim Guide
adapters.methodology_note: Official site states the guide was written by Fahd ibn Saalim Baa Hammaam, revised and approved by Muslim scholars, translated into 26 languages, and distributed with free electronic products.
adapters.release_policy: The site identifies The Modern Guide as the sole property holder; record exact item-level permission before public PDF redistribution.

runtime_policy.source_enumeration_for_acquisition: All active source adapters relevant to a matrix cell must be inspected; PDF capability is discovered from the source at runtime and is not used as a prefilter.
